scope: Static code trace of identified paths; not exhaustive product certification

claw: Monitor due → heartbeat admission → agent turn. /hooks/wake can enqueue context and request an immediate heartbeat; next-heartbeat queues context only.
週期或事件皆可喚醒；不是只靠固定 timer。
For at / every / cron schedules: due job → payload dispatch. Payload selects heartbeat, system event, agent turn or script work. Event schedule variants are listed below.
排程到期後依 payload 分流；payload 是工作資料，不是 timer。
Validated hook → session admission → isolated agent turn. This route can submit work directly without waiting for a recurring heartbeat.
外部事件可直接提交回合，和 /hooks/wake 路徑不同。
Supervised command completes → watcher fire → shared cron execution admission → one-shot payload. Completion is the trigger, not a deadline.
監看的命令結束後觸發一次，不是固定時間到期。
Lines arrive from a supervised command
stdout / stderr → match and bounded batch → fireBatch → cron.run with stream context. Batch timing coalesces events; it does not create them.
串流事件聚合後執行；batch timer 只是合併事件。
A scheduled check or stream batch passes a condition
Headless trigger script reads input / saved state → fire:false skips payload; fire:true dispatches it. No model needed to evaluate the script itself.
排程或串流先跑條件 script，符合才進入工作。
Run-scoped delay request → success / bounds checks → persist next due time. This modifies a schedule; it does not create a separate event source.
調整下次排程時間，是排程內的控制能力。
Eligibility → delayed background review → permitted workshop changes. Distinct from checking external work.
完成工作後符合門檻才回顧，不是每次 timer 都做。
Managed cron → memory consolidation / promotion / diary. Memory maintenance is not evidence of new external goal discovery.
以排程維護記憶；不能直接等同自行發現新工作。
Goal state and controls exist. A universal post-final automatic continuation producer was not established in this audit.
有目標狀態不代表已證實所有回合都會自動續跑。
hermes: tick → claim due job → run_one_job → fresh agent session → delivery / next schedule. no_agent takes a script-only branch.
獨立排程工作；no_agent 可只跑 script，不呼叫模型。
Authenticate → event / payload filters → optional script → prompt → MessageEvent → handle_message. deliver_only bypasses the agent.
外部事件經過濾才進 agent；純通知可略過模型。
Watcher checks session / user queue → admitted normal conversation turn. Recurrence does not itself define a new goal.
在 session 內週期注入既定指令。
fire_tick → repeated turn → marker / optional judge / caps → stop or next tick. Separate from persistent-goal continuation.
按時間重跑，可調節節奏；和 goal 續跑分開。
Eligible turn finishes; goal remains active
Post-turn hook → gates + judge + budget → continue / wait / pause / done. Continuation enters the session queue.
回合完成後判定是否繼續已交付目標，不必等 cron。
Periodic board sweep → promote / claim → spawn assigned worker. State makes work eligible; polling discovers that state.
任務狀態決定可否開工；週期掃描只是偵測方法。
Finalizer → background review → restricted improvement writes. This is maintenance after work, not a new external assignment.
工作後回顧是另一條路徑；寫入範圍受限制。
Authenticated /api/cron/fire → provider claim → shared run_one_job. Logically time-based, although its transport is a webhook.
時間排程可用 webhook 派送；不能因此當成業務事件。
Scheduled source check; changed or first observation
Configured script / URL → exact-output hash → skip, error or agent context; delivery suppression is a later decision.
指定來源的內容有變才喚醒；首次觀察也執行，並非語意重要性分類。
ob: Worker sweep → durable work item → lease → current owner/access checks → channel turn → next occurrence.
時間到期的例行工作，使用持久佇列與租約。
Typed task + trusted identity / grants → durable hop → claimed delivery → recipient Bot turn. Assigned work, not self-created goals.
另一個 agent 派工即可觸發接收者，不限時間排程。
A delegated turn produces an answer
Successful forward hop with answer → queued relay → follow-up delivery. answerIn prevents relay-of-relay recursion.
委派完成後結果回送；這是 handoff 的後續路徑。
Lease heartbeat · not an agent wake
A claimed run is still executing
Renew queue / thread ownership while work runs. No new task or model turn is created by the lease renewal itself.
heartbeat 在此用於續租，不是主動檢查工作。
gr: Poll transport → validate / acknowledge fire → guarded automation run. Upstream scheduling semantics are not proven by this local consumer.
polling 是接收方式；不能據此推定上游只有 cron。
Event collected → background queue → transcript run. This is event follow-up in reconstructed host code.
事件進入背景佇列，再觸發回合。
Completion → ownership / duplicate checks → revive or drain waiting transcript → follow-up run.
背景工作完成可喚回等待中的對話。
Validate action / goal identity → anti-spin guard → simulated user continuation. The automatic producer of that action remains unverified.
看到續跑處理器，但不能宣稱完整自動目標迴圈。
v: Update progress → propose next task from state / history → next rollout, until iteration limit. This selects tasks within the assigned exploration domain.
在運行中的探索迴圈，依成果選下一項任務。
Environment feedback + critic → revise code / retry within rollout bounds. Retry of a task and selection of a new task are different stages.
任務內修正重試，與 curriculum 選新任務分開。
